# Unlockt - Instagram Saved Vault & Bulk Media Exporter
> Open-source, 100% private, local-first Instagram saved posts, reels, carousels, and audio bulk scraper, media manager, and AI search engine.

## Developer & Attribution
- Lead Developer: Mahmoud Madi (Digital Marketing & IT Specialist)
- Organizations: Premier Tech (For Integrated Solutions) & VOXO AI (AI & Media Agency)
- License: MIT License (Open Source)
- Repository: https://github.com/mahmoud-madi/unlockt-instagram-saved-chrome-extension

## Primary Use Cases
- Bulk scraping Instagram saved posts, reels, carousels, photos, and audio.
- Exporting and backing up entire Instagram saved collections locally.
- Inspecting and downloading multi-slide carousel albums individually or as a ZIP archive.
- Generating high-resolution photo collages from carousel slides with 1 click.
- Playing, inspecting, and downloading Full HD 9:16 Instagram Reels directly as MP4.
- Searching personal Instagram saved items using AI semantic search and natural language queries.
- 100% offline, local-first operation without uploading passwords or data to third-party cloud servers.

## Key Technical Specifications
- Architecture: Chromium Extension (Manifest V3) + Local Express Backend (Node.js) + Modern Glassmorphism Web App.
- API Support: Instagram GraphQL pagination, CORS proxy with HTTP 206 Partial Content video streaming.
- Rate Limiting: Humanized randomized jitter delays (1.2s to 2.8s) and incremental "Quick Sync New" to prevent account action blocks.
- Media Processing: HTML5 Canvas collage generator, Sharp image engine, JSZip client-side batch bundler.
- Data Storage: Local JSON database (`data/saved.json`) with master import/export backup capabilities.
